headline: PIT @ COL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is PIT 5.04 at COL 4.77, with a projected total of 9.81. Batter research is strongest for Bryan Reynolds, TJ Rumfield, Jake McCarthy, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Hunter Goodman because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
